results.flow_security_relevance: Enforces lifecycle state (Status.NftWon or Status.CashWon), single-redemption invariance (!winnerRedeemed), winning-ticket proof (either matching pre-settled winningTicketId or proving _ticketRanges[ticketId] covers winningEntry), and bearer authorization (msg.sender == ownerOf(ticketId)). Crucially, if inline _settleWinningTicket(ticketId) executes before the ownerOf check fails, the revert at NotTicketOwner rolls back the inline settlement state changes as well.

results.flow_security_relevance: Enforces lifecycle state (Status.NftWon or Status.CashWon), single-redemption invariance (!winnerRedeemed), winning-ticket proof (either matching pre-settled winningTicketId or proving _ticketRanges[ticketId] covers winningEntry), and bearer authorization (msg.sender == ownerOf(ticketId)).
